name: Scenario F: Payment Logging
description: Logs Stripe payments to HubSpot, routes setup vs recurring payments, and emails errors to {{env.ADMIN_EMAIL}} via Resend.
comments: STRIPE WEBHOOK VERIFICATION NOTE: Make.com's Stripe webhook module automatically validates the Stripe-Signature header using your configured Stripe webhook secret. Ensure the webhook secret from your Stripe Dashboard (Developers > Webhooks > your endpoint > Signing secret) is entered in the Stripe module connection settings. Do NOT expose this secret in code or logs. Stripe signs each event with HMAC-SHA256; Make verifies this before passing data downstream. If verification fails, the scenario will not process the event.

metadata.note: Extracts and normalizes payment fields from Stripe event. Amount is converted from cents to dollars. Payment date formatted in America/New_York (Eastern Time).
HTTP POST to HubSpot CRM v3 Companies Search API. Searches for a company whose domain matches the email domain extracted from customer_email.
HTTP POST to HubSpot CRM v3 Notes API. Creates an engagement note of type payment_received associated with the matched company. associationTypeId 279 = Company-to-Note.
Routes payment based on description content. Branch A handles setup payments; Branch B handles monthly/recurring payments.
Searches HubSpot for deals in 'Proposal Sent' stage (dealstage = env.HUBSPOT_STAGE_PROPOSAL_SENT) associated with the matched company.
Branch A: Moves the matched deal from 'Proposal Sent' (env.HUBSPOT_STAGE_PROPOSAL_SENT) to 'Closed Won' (env.HUBSPOT_STAGE_CLOSED_WON) in HubSpot pipeline.
Branch B: Logs a recurring monthly payment activity note in HubSpot associated with the matched company. Prefixed with [RECURRING] for easy filtering.

Catches any error from modules 2-8 and sends a detailed failure email to env.ADMIN_EMAIL via the Resend API (POST https://api.resend.com/emails) with full payment details, Stripe IDs, error message, and the failed module name for fast manual remediation. Timestamp shown in America/New_York (Eastern Time).

stripe.label: CWI Stripe Connection
stripe.note: Requires Stripe API key (restricted key with webhook read access) and the webhook signing secret for HMAC-SHA256 signature verification.

setupInstructions.step1_stripe_webhook: In Stripe Dashboard: Developers > Webhooks > Add endpoint. Set endpoint URL to your Make.com webhook URL. Select event type: payment_intent.succeeded. Copy the Signing Secret and paste it into the Stripe module connection in Make.com.
setupInstructions.step2_hubspot_scopes: Create a HubSpot Private App with these scopes: crm.objects.companies.read, crm.objects.deals.read, crm.objects.deals.write, crm.objects.notes.write, crm.objects.contacts.read. Store the generated access token in the env.HUBSPOT_ACCESS_TOKEN environment variable referenced by the HTTP module Authorization headers.
setupInstructions.step3_deal_stages: Verify your HubSpot pipeline stage IDs. This blueprint references env.HUBSPOT_STAGE_PROPOSAL_SENT for Proposal Sent and env.HUBSPOT_STAGE_CLOSED_WON for Closed Won. Run GET https://api.hubapi.com/crm/v3/pipelines/deals to confirm your pipeline stage IDs and set the env vars accordingly. Also define env.HUBSPOT_STAGE_CLOSED_LOST for downstream scenarios.
setupInstructions.step4_error_email: The error handler sends to env.ADMIN_EMAIL via the Resend API. Set env.RESEND_API_KEY, env.CWI_ALERT_FROM_ADDRESS (a verified Resend sender domain address), and env.ADMIN_EMAIL. No SMTP/Gmail connection is required.
setupInstructions.step5_testing: Test with Stripe CLI: stripe trigger payment_intent.succeeded. Then test Branch A by setting description to include 'setup', and Branch B by setting description to include 'monthly'. Verify HubSpot notes and deal stage changes.
